arxiv-2101-05396.title: Underdamped stochastic thermodynamic engines in contact with a heat bath with arbitrary temperature profile
arxiv-2101-05396.creator: Olga Movilla Miangolarra, Rui Fu, Amirhossein Taghvaei, Yongxin Chen, Tryphon T. Georgiou
arxiv-2101-05396.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Olga Movilla Miangolarra, Rui Fu, Amirhossein Taghvaei, Yongxin Chen, Tryphon T. Georgiou. We study thermodynamic processes in contact with a heat bath that may have an arbitrary time-varying periodic temperature profile. Within the framework of stochastic thermodynamics, and for models of thermodynamic engines in the idealized case of underdamped particles in the low friction regime subject to a harmonic potential, we derive explicit bounds as well as optimal control protocols that draw maximum power and achieve maximum efficiency at any specified level of power.

arxiv-2201-05023.title: Stereo Magnification with Multi-Layer Images
arxiv-2201-05023.creator: T. Khakhulin D. Korzhenkov P. Solovev G. Sterkin A.-T. Ardelean V. Lempitsky, [7pt] Samsung AI Center -- Moscow
arxiv-2201-05023.description: Abstract Representing scenes with multiple semitransparent colored layers has been a popular and successful choice for real-time novel view synthesis. Existing approaches infer colors and transparency values over regularly spaced layers of planar or spherical shape. In this work, we introduce a new view synthesis approach based on multiple semitransparent layers with scene-adapted geometry.

arxiv-2312-05426.title: Enhancing the Electron Pair Approximation with Measurements on Trapped Ion Quantum Computers
arxiv-2312-05426.creator: Luning Zhao, Qingfeng Wang, Joshua Goings, Kyujin Shin, Woomin Kyoung, Seunghyo Noh, Young Min Rhee, Kyungmin Kim
arxiv-2312-05426.description: Abstract The electron pair approximation offers a resource efficient variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) approach for quantum chemistry simulations on quantum computers. With the number of entangling gates scaling quadratically with system size and a constant energy measurement overhead, the orbital optimized unitary pair coupled cluster double (oo-upCCD) ansatz strikes a balance between accuracy and efficiency on today’s quantum computers.

arxiv-2407-13675.title: MeshSegmenter: Zero-Shot Mesh Semantic Segmentation via Texture Synthesis
arxiv-2407-13675.creator: Ziming Zhong, Yanyu Xu, Jing Li, Jiale Xu, Zhengxin Li, Chaohui Yu, Shenghua Gao
arxiv-2407-13675.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ziming Zhong, Yanyu Xu, Jing Li, Jiale Xu, Zhengxin Li, Chaohui Yu, Shenghua Gao. We present MeshSegmenter, a simple yet effective framework designed for zero-shot 3D semantic segmentation. This model successfully extends the powerful capabilities of 2D segmentation models to 3D meshes, delivering accurate 3D segmentation across diverse meshes and segment descriptions. Specifically, our model leverages the Segment Anything Model (SAM) model to segment the target regions from images rendered from the 3D shape.

arxiv-2409-09010.title: Contri(e)ve: Context + Retrieve for Scholarly Question Answering
arxiv-2409-09010.creator: Kanchan Shivashankar, Nadine Steinmetz
arxiv-2409-09010.description: Abstract Scholarly communication is a rapid growing field containing a wealth of knowledge. However, due to its unstructured and document format, it is challenging to extract useful information from them through conventional document retrieval methods. Scholarly knowledge graphs solve this problem, by representing the documents in a semantic network, providing, hidden insights, summaries and ease of accessibility through queries.

arxiv-2410-21506.title: Fast-Reconfiguring Liquid-Crystal RIS for Pervasive Wireless Networks
arxiv-2410-21506.creator: Luis F. Abanto-Leon 1 § , Robin Neuder 2 § , Waqar Ahmed 5 , Alejandro Jimenez Saez 2 , Vahid Jamali 2 , Arash Asadi 3
arxiv-2410-21506.description: Abstract Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) have emerged as a key technology for dynamically reshaping wireless propagation, enhancing coverage and mitigating blockages to enable more pervasive network connectivity. However, implementing RISs at high frequencies remains challenging due to the cost and power demands of semiconductor-based components.

arxiv-2411-13380.title: Bounds on the Treewidth of Level- k k Rooted Phylogenetic Networks
arxiv-2411-13380.creator: Alexey Markin, Sriram Vijendran, Oliver Eulenstein
arxiv-2411-13380.description: Abstract Phylogenetic networks are directed acyclic graphs that depict the genomic evolution of related taxa. Reticulation nodes in such networks (nodes with more than one parent) represent reticulate evolutionary events, such as recombination, reassortment, hybridization, or horizontal gene transfer. arxiv-2504-20583.creator: D.I. Tyurin, V.V. Strelkov, S.V. Popruzhenko
arxiv-2504-20583.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by D.I. Tyurin, V.V. Strelkov, S.V. Popruzhenko. We consider double ionization of negative bromine ion Br − {\rm Br}^{-} in intense linearly polarized low-frequency laser fields. arxiv-2505-11195.title: Decentralized Framework for Teleportation in Quantum Core Interconnects
arxiv-2505-11195.creator: Rajeswari Suance P S 1 , Ruchika Gupta 2 , Maurizio Palesi 3 , John Jose 1
arxiv-2505-11195.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rajeswari Suance P S 1 , Ruchika Gupta 2 , Maurizio Palesi 3 , John Jose 1. Multi-core quantum computing architectures offer a promising and scalable solution to the challenges of integrating large number of qubits into existing monolithic chip design. However, the issue of transferring quantum information across the cores remains unresolved. Quantum Teleportation offers a potential approach for efficient qubit transfer, but existing methods primarily rely on centralized interconnection mechanisms for teleportation, which may limit scalability and parallel communication.

arxiv-2507-09480.title: Discrete Differential Principle for Continuous Smooth Function Representation
arxiv-2507-09480.creator: Guoyou Wang, Yihua Tan, Shiqi Liu
arxiv-2507-09480.description: Abstract Taylor’s formula holds significant importance in function representation, such as solving differential difference equations, ordinary differential equations, partial differential equations, and further promotes applications in visual perception, complex control, fluid mechanics, weather forecasting and thermodynamics. However, the Taylor’s formula suffers from the curse of dimensionality and error propagation during derivative computation in discrete situations.

arxiv-2509-06083.title: Second-order multilane traffic flow models: from the microscopic to the macroscopic scale
arxiv-2509-06083.creator: Matteo Piu, Giuseppe Visconti, Gabriella Puppo
arxiv-2509-06083.description: Abstract This study addresses multilane vehicular traffic modelling, focusing on the transition between microscopic (individual vehicle-based) to macroscopic (aggregate flow-based) descriptions. While previous research on multilane traffic has largely focused on first-order models, we derive two new multilane second-order macroscopic models by applying a microscopic-to-macroscopic limit to the multilane Bando–Follow-the-Leader model.

arxiv-2601-04121.title: MORPHFED: Federated Learning for Cross-institutional Blood Morphology Analysis
arxiv-2601-04121.creator: Gabriel Ansah, Eden Ruffell, Delmiro Fernandez-Reyes, Petru Manescu
arxiv-2601-04121.description: Abstract Automated blood morphology analysis can support hematological diagnostics in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) but remains sensitive to dataset shifts from staining variability, imaging differences, and rare morphologies. Building centralized datasets to capture this diversity is often infeasible due to privacy regulations and data-sharing restrictions.

pmc-10657814.title: Clinicopathological characteristics, molecular landscape, and biomarker landscape for predicting the efficacy of PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors in Chinese population with mismatch repair deficient urothelial carcinoma: a real-world study
pmc-10657814.creator: Yu-Ting Ma, Fang Hua, Xiu-Ming Zhong, Ying-Jie Xue, Jia Li, Yi-Cong Nie, Xue-Dong Zhang, Ji-Wei Ma, Cun-Hu Lin, Hao-Zhuang Zhang, Wei He, Dan Sha, Miao-Qing Zhao, Zhi-Gang Yao
pmc-10657814.description: Urothelial carcinoma (UC) with deficient mismatch repair (dMMR) is a specific subtype of UC characterized by the loss of mismatch repair (MMR) proteins and its association with Lynch syndrome (LS). However, comprehensive real-world data on the incidence, clinicopathological characteristics, molecular landscape, and biomarker landscape for predicting the efficacy of PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors in the Chinese patients with dMMR UC remains unknown.

pmc-11482547.creator: Giuseppe D’Abbronzo, Renato Franco, Cecilia Salzillo, Carlo Pietro Campobasso, Maurizio Municinò, Alessandro Feola, Andrea Ronchi, Giulia Ottaviani
pmc-11482547.description: Background: Coronary artery disease (CAD) underlies most cases of myocardial infarction (MI), causing or at least contributing to oxygen supply–demand mismatch and myocardial injury, so a careful and reliable evaluation of the main coronary arteries and large branches is a key moment of autopsy in order to establish the cause of death.

This study aims to examine the possible associations between cybervictimization and online sexual harassment among 697 Italian adolescents (Mage = 15.17; SD = 0.68; 42.

pmc-12409013.title: Effect of cotton roll biting on pain perception during orthodontic bracket debonding using Weingart pliers: A randomized controlled trial
pmc-12409013.creator: Belal A Drmch, Kinda Sultan, Mohammad Y Hajeer, Shadi Azzawi, Ahamd S Burhan
pmc-12409013.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of biting on a cotton roll in reducing pain during metal bracket removal using a Weingart plier compared with the conventional method.MethodsThis two-arm, parallel-group, randomized controlled trial included 36 patients (11 males and 25 females) with a mean age of 20.5 ± 3.08 years (range: 16–25 years).

pmc-12801978.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices of community pharmacists on pharmacological approaches to smoking cessation in Saudi Arabia
pmc-12801978.creator: Fahad S Alshehri
pmc-12801978.description: BackgroundPharmacological therapies are key component of effective smoking-cessation management; however, the extent to which community pharmacists are prepared to deliver these interventions remains unclear.ObjectiveThis study explored the knowledge, attitudes, and practical engagement of community pharmacists toward pharmacological interventions of smoking cessation, and to examine the influence of demographic factors on these outcomes.

pmc-12835168.title: Heterogeneity in gender differences in self-reported political preferences, trust, and well-being across 39 European countries
pmc-12835168.creator: Yifan Yang, Magnus Johannesson, Frank Fossen, Levent Neyse, Felix Holzmeister
pmc-12835168.description: Previous research suggests that women tend to self-report higher life satisfaction and happiness, lower health status and trust, and more left-leaning political preferences than men. We revisit the gender gap in these outcome variables using random-effects meta-analysis, aggregating data across 39 countries surveyed in the European Social Survey (n ≈ 500,000).

pmc-13213130.title: Household disposal of unused and expired medications in Bahir Dar City, Northwest Ethiopia: Knowledge, attitudes, practices, and factors associated with good disposal practices
pmc-13213130.creator: Biset Asrade Mekonnen, Tefera Minwagaw Biadigilign, Gizachew Motbaynor Alene, Dagninet Derebe Abie
pmc-13213130.description: IntroductionProper household management of unused and expired medications reduces environmental and public health risks. The aim of this study was to assess household knowledge, attitudes, and disposal practices of unused and expired medications, and identifies factors associated with good disposal practices among households in Bahir Dar City, Northwest Ethiopia.

pmc-13335674.title: Introgressed Variation in TaMYB7‐A1 Drives Graded Dormancy and Climate‐Adaptive Pre‐Harvest Sprouting Resistance in Wheat
pmc-13335674.creator: Hao Wang, Dongzhi Wang, Yafei Guo, Qi Zheng, Min Zhang, James Simmonds, Jian Hou, Xuemei Liu, Xuelei Lin, Xiaomin Bie, Xiansheng Zhang, Xiaohui Li, Yuan Chen, Xueyong Zhang, Cristobal Uauy, Fei Lu, Chengcai Chu, Zhixi Tian, Jun Xiao
pmc-13335674.description: Pre‐harvest sprouting (PHS) poses a major threat to wheat yield and quality, yet the genetic basis of seed dormancy underlying PHS resistance remains poorly understood. Here, through integrated genome‐wide association and transcriptomic analyses, we identify TaMYB7‐A1 as a key regulator of seed dormancy and PHS resistance.

pmc-13342085.title: Ethanol precipitation with cooling enables rapid purification of gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) with increased yield and preserved solution-state organisation
pmc-13342085.creator: Paritat Thaitalay, Ashish Pandit, Lauma Ievina, Julija Bulatova, Antons Sizovs, Janis Locs
pmc-13342085.description: Gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) is a widely used photocrosslinkable biomaterial, yet routine laboratory synthesis is constrained by multi-day dialysis required to remove cytotoxic methacrylic anhydride (MAA) and methacrylic acid (MA). Here we introduce a simple post-reaction precipitation of GelMA in ethanol (EtOH) as a faster purification route.

pmc-13456566.title: The Efficacy of Whole Blood Exchange-Lymphoplasmapheresis Combined with Transfusion in Sepsis with Anemia
pmc-13456566.creator: Run Yao, Danyang Yan, Xiangjie Fu, Huan Li, Siya Pei, Wenyu Yin, Cheng Mei, Xinying Zhang, Wanting Huang, Bijuan Li, Ning Li
pmc-13456566.description: Background:Sepsis progression is driven by a dysregulated immune response and persistent leukocyte activation. Inflammation-induced hemolysis also places septic patients at high risk for anemia. Whole blood exchange has shown efficacy in severe autoimmune hemolytic anemia. Consequently, whole blood exchange-lymphoplasmapheresis combined with transfusion (WLCT) is hypothesized as a potential adjunctive therapy for sepsis complicated by anemia.

In contrast, milk that contains the A1 type of beta-casein may cause gastrointestinal discomfort due to the release of the peptide beta-casomorphin-7 during digestion.

pmc-13682037.creator: Mojtaba Hedayati Ch, Zahra Bostani Khalesi, Mahmood Abedinzade
pmc-13682037.description: BackgroundNon-hormonal pharmacotherapies are widely used to manage depressive and anxiety symptoms in peri- and postmenopausal women, but comparative evidence across drug classes remains heterogeneous.ObjectiveTo systematically evaluate the efficacy and safety of non-hormonal pharmacological interventions for depressive and anxiety symptoms during the menopausal transition and postmenopause.
